questions.stemEn: A child has chronic cough and difficulty swallowing solid food. A barium swallow image suggests a vascular ring. Which test is listed as most likely to confirm the diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يطبع Correct answer: B، لكن شرحه يقول صراحةً إن CT angiography هي الطريقة الشائعة للتعريف النهائي بطبيعة vascular ring بعد barium swallow. لذلك المفتاح والشرح متعارضان.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Chest X-ray قد تكون supportive لكنها لا تؤكد anatomy الوعائية حسب شرح المصدر؛ CT angiography هي المذكورة كـdefinitive identification.
questions.clinicalPearl: Vascular-ring confirmation generally requires anatomic vascular imaging; the source key conflicts with its explanation.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A 4-month-old infant has recurrent wheezing and spits up after feeds. He is growing appropriately and has no other significant findings. What is the most likely diagnosis according to the source?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Gastroesophageal reflux ويصف الرضيع كـhappy spitter بسبب النمو الجيد وغياب red flags. لكنه يذكر أيضًا أن wheezing should prompt evaluation for other causes، لذا يبقى السؤال imperfect.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: وجود wheezing يجعل reactive airway disease أو أسباب أخرى ضمن differential؛ المصدر نفسه يحذر من إسناد respiratory symptoms إلى GER بسهولة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Good growth supports uncomplicated reflux, but recurrent wheeze should not automatically be attributed to GER.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: An 11-year-old has nonbilious vomiting twice weekly and substernal burning after meals. What is the most appropriate next step?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار PPI trial، لكن شرحه يذكر أن empiric acid suppression عادةً تكون 4–8 weeks، وليس أسبوعين. لذلك حُفظ مفتاح D مع flag للتناقض في المدة.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Endoscopy تُفكر إذا استمرت/تكررت الأعراض أو وُجد dysphagia؛ ondansetron لا يعالج acid reflux، وelimination diet ليست الخطوة المختارة بلا قرائن غذائية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Typical adolescent heartburn can be approached with lifestyle measures plus an empiric PPI trial, but the source duration is inconsistent.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A young girl has recurrent epigastric pain that worsens with eating for two months and uses ibuprofen. What is the next investigation?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Endoscopy with biopsy في سياق persistent epigastric pain مع NSAID exposure.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: H. pylori antibody testing وحده لا يقيم mucosal injury ولا يثبت سبب الألم في هذا السيناريو حسب مفتاح المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Persistent upper-GI symptoms with NSAID exposure may warrant endoscopic evaluation.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A 5-week-old girl has progressive forceful post-feed vomiting and remains hungry after vomiting, consistent with hypertrophic pyloric stenosis. Which listed factor is a risk factor?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Prematurity ويذكر ضمن risk factors: prematurity, cesarean delivery, maternal smoking, young maternal age وmacrolide exposure.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Female gender ليست عامل الخطورة المعتاد لأن HPS أكثر شيوعًا في الذكور؛ breech وmaternal pertussis vaccine لا يذكرهما المصدر كعوامل خطورة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Prematurity is one of several reported risk factors for hypertrophic pyloric stenosis.
